The companion §1.6 explicitly checks these hypotheses. From the N129 identities, e²=e; e=0 would imply ba=1 and c=bac=b(ac)=0, contradiction; e=1 contradicts ab=1.
supplied_vs_acquired: BLR/Formanek theorem is published; N129 graph, probability, disk extraction and finite presentation were not externally validated or emitted.
